metadata.title: How to Turn 1 Piece of Content Into 10?
metadata.audience: Creators, marketers and students who make one long-form piece and want it to work across every platform
metadata.greeting_note: hello lexicon: French (one word). Namaste/Hola/Hej/Ciao already used in this series. Chip @Shubh & @HumanitariansAI on every Claude page (B00 beginning, B03 middle, B08 + B09 end) and on the outro.
metadata.note: ai-explainer, Plain register. New reel (not a variation of ai-content-vs-human-creativity): one long-form video → atoms → ten native formats → reshape-not-copy → release runway → quality gate. No statistics; every example (copy, schedule, the 7-of-10 gate) is labelled illustrative. Reel-local C3 scenes live in runtime/remotion/src/scenes/OneIntoTen.tsx (+ OneIntoTen916.tsx). Outro is HandleTitleOutro. Never publishes.
metadata.brand_note: Shubh x Humanitarians AI co-branded channel: claude skin, HAI mark, chip @Shubh & @HumanitariansAI (brand key claude-shubh in runtime/qc/brand_labels.json).

skin_warnings: B10: palette=claude but the outro is 'HandleTitleOutro' — OUTRO LAW wants ClaudeTitleOutro

beats.role_note: COLD OPEN LAW — Claude UI first; the ask lands answered. Chip @Shubh & @HumanitariansAI (beginning).
beats.narration_text: Bonjour. Most creators make one great video, post it once, and move on. So I asked Claude how to turn one piece of content into ten.

show.event: the ask types into the composer

props.command: I just finished one long-form video. How do I turn it into ten pieces of content — Reels, TikToks, LinkedIn posts, a carousel, a blog and an email — without starting from scratch?
output: pull the atoms out of the video
reshape each atom for its platform
release them over time — then cut the weak ones

beats.role_note: EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY LAW — hesitant writer. Misconception: repurposing = COPYING one video into ten posts → it means RESHAPING one video into ten posts. Narration opens 'Hi, I'm Shubh, and this video is about…' per the brief.
beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Shubh, and this video is about turning one piece of content into ten. Not by copying one post everywhere, but by reshaping one long video into Reels, TikToks, LinkedIn posts, a carousel, a blog and an email.

show.event: types 'One long video, copied into ten posts.'

props.text:
One long video,
copied into
ten posts.

beats.role_note: FRAMEWORK — a long video is a bundle of atoms. The video card splits; atom chips fly into four labelled bins in spoken order. One accent: the Big idea chip.
beats.narration_text: Here's the trick. A long video isn't one piece of content. It's a bundle of smaller ones: a big idea, a few stories, some quotable lines and practical steps. Pull those atoms out first, then package each one.

show.event: 'a bundle' — the card cracks into atom chips
chips fly into four bins in spoken order: Big idea, Stories, Quotes, Steps
'Pull the atoms out first' line + terracotta ring on Big idea

beats.role_note: ASK→RESULT micro-beat, mid-reel Claude page (chip @Shubh & @HumanitariansAI, middle). Command pre-typed (inner beat). Output lines are the plan, not fabricated findings.
beats.narration_text: So I give Claude the transcript and ask it to pull out the atoms, each with a timestamp.

show.event: composer with the ask already typed

props.command: Here's the transcript of my video. Pull out the atoms — the big idea, the stories, the most quotable lines and the practical steps — each with its timestamp. Then map every atom to a format.

beats.role_note: RESULT of B03 / WORKED EXAMPLE — ten numbered tiles light in spoken order, each tagged with the atom that feeds it; a counter climbs 1→10 and lands in terracotta on 'That's ten'.
beats.narration_text: Now each atom becomes a format. The big idea becomes a Reel, a TikTok and a YouTube Short. A story becomes a LinkedIn post. The steps become a carousel. The transcript becomes a blog, and the blog becomes an email. The quotes become a thread and a quote card. The audio becomes a podcast clip. That's ten.

show.event: ten empty numbered tile slots (5 × 2) + counter '1'
Reel, TikTok, Short light (tag: Big idea)

beats.role_note: Reshape, don't copy — three identical pasted copies are struck through (accent) on 'copy and paste', then each column reshapes into its platform's native opening and ending on the spoken platform name. Side-by-side comparison held.
beats.narration_text: But ten doesn't mean copy and paste. Here's one idea on three platforms. On TikTok, it opens with a hook. On LinkedIn, it opens with a story and ends on a question. In an email, it's a note to one person, with one link. Same idea, three shapes.

show.event: three platform columns, each holding the same pasted text
terracotta strike through all three copies
idea card above: 'Make it once, then make it fit.'
TikTok column reshapes: opens with a hook
LinkedIn column reshapes: story opening, question ending
Email column reshapes: a note to one person, one link

beats.role_note: Release over time — a two-week runway; the long video lands on day 1 as the anchor (accent), pieces drop onto later days in spoken order; ink arrows point back to the anchor on 'points back'. Example schedule, illustrative.
beats.narration_text: And don't post all ten on day one. The long video goes out first as the anchor. Short clips follow early to pull people in, then the carousel and LinkedIn posts, then the blog and email. Every piece points back to the original.

show.event: long video block lands on Day 1, terracotta 'anchor' outline
ink arrows arc from every piece back to the anchor

props.sparkLine: Don't post all ten at once.

beats.role_note: FALSIFIABILITY — ten is a ceiling, not a target. Three check chips light on the spoken questions; a terracotta gate sweeps the ten tiles; three drop to 45% with 'cut'; '7 ship' + verdict. Example, illustrative.
beats.narration_text: Ten is a ceiling, not a target. Before anything ships, run three checks. Does it make sense on its own? Does it feel native to the platform? Would you stop scrolling for it? If not, cut it. Seven strong posts beat ten weak ones.

show.event: check chips light in spoken order: Stands alone? · Native? · Scroll-stopping?
terracotta gate sweeps left→right; three tiles drop, tagged 'cut'
'7 ship' + verdict 'Seven strong beat ten weak.'

beats.role_note: Verdict artifact page (Claude UI is the subject). Chip @Shubh & @HumanitariansAI via brandLabel (end).
beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Make one strong piece. Pull out its atoms. Reshape each one for its platform. Release them over time, and ship only what passes the checks.

show.event: five lines stagger in, the rule last

props.artifactTitle: How to Turn 1 Piece of Content Into 10 — one page
artifactLines: Pull out its atoms: idea, stories, quotes, steps.
Reshape each atom for its platform — never copy-paste.
Release over two weeks; every piece points back.
The rule: ship only what passes the three checks.

beats.role_note: HANDOFF LAW — prompt read aloud verbatim, then discussed. Chip @Shubh & @HumanitariansAI (end).
beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this into Claude: Here's the transcript of my latest video. Pull out its atoms, and turn them into ten pieces for different platforms. Flag any piece that wouldn't make sense on its own. That last line matters. It makes Claude your first quality check, so you only polish the pieces worth posting.

show.event: greeting 'Your turn.'; the suggested prompt types in

beats.narration_text: How to turn one piece of content into ten. Make it once, then make it fit. At Shubh, and at Humanitarians A I.
